mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below its 12-month moving average signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% and remains above this level for two consecutive months, it indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in federal funds rate signals labor market tightening offset by monetary policy, boosting equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market tightening with monetary offset
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and FEDFUNDS increase fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During high consumer spending periods (RSAFS above 90th percentile), strong earnings expectations drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS exceeds its 90th percentile.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls above its 12-month moving average indicates labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate falls below 4.5% and remains below this level for three consecutive months, it signals a tight labor market triggering inflation concerns and monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and decline in industrial production signals a shift from manufacturing to housing-led economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST increase and INDPRO decline fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial contraction (INDPRO below 12-month moving average), weakening economic activity and corporate earnings expectations cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average.
